project.name: treetracker-query-api
project.description: RESTful query API that exposes Greenstand treetracker data (tree captures, planters/growers, organizations, species, countries, tokens, transactions, wallets) to client apps such as the web map. It is read-only over a PostgreSQL database and follows a Domain Driven Design layered architecture: Express routers validate and translate HTTP requests, business models orchestrate and build HATEOAS links, and knex/pg repositories run the SQL.

nodes.name: Tree & Capture Data
nodes.summary: Core observation data of the platform. Exposes queries over trees, processed captures, and raw (unprocessed) captures, including filtered lists, counts, single-record lookups, and featured trees. This is the primary evidence that a tree was planted and geolocated.

businessRules: Queries are read-only; the API never mutates capture data
Trees and captures can be filtered by organization, date range, tag, wallet, and geometry
Featured trees are returned via a dedicated endpoint (with a deprecated hardcoded fallback)
crossDomainInteractions: Provides tree/capture coordinates that the Geospatial & Mapping domain aggregates into map bounds
Captures are referenced by tokens in the Token & Transaction Ledger domain
Stakeholder resources link to featured trees of this domain via HATEOAS links

nodes.name: Stakeholder Directory
nodes.summary: The people and organizations behind the trees. Exposes planters, grower accounts (v2), organizations (v1 and v2), and stakeholder lookups. Builds HATEOAS resource links to related trees, organizations, and species.

businessRules: Planters, growers, and organizations can be listed by filter, fetched by id, or requested as featured
Grower accounts expose counts, featured selection, wallets, and selfies
Responses embed HATEOAS links to featured trees, organizations, and species
V2 organization queries additionally support grower-based lookups
crossDomainInteractions: Links to featured trees in the Tree & Capture Data domain
Links to species owned or planted in the Species Catalog domain
Grower accounts reference wallets in the Token & Transaction Ledger domain

nodes.name: Species Catalog
nodes.summary: Catalog of tree species. Exposes filtered species lists and single-species lookups, and supports grouping species by organization, planter, or wallet with counts.

businessRules: Species can be filtered by keyword, morphology, and range with pagination
Species can be grouped and counted by organization, planter, or wallet
crossDomainInteractions: Referenced by Stakeholder Directory HATEOAS links for a planter's or organization's species

nodes.name: Geospatial & Mapping
nodes.summary: Spatial support for rendering the web map. Computes map bounding boxes from tree capture coordinates, resolves the nearest GIS feature to a lat/lon point using PostGIS, and serves country geometries plus a planting leaderboard.

businessRules: Bounds are computed by planter, wallet, or organization from capture coordinates
Nearest-feature lookups validate coordinate inputs before running raw PostGIS distance queries
Country responses serialize centroids as GeoJSON
Country leaderboard aggregates planting counts by region
Country responses can be served from an LRU cache when caching is enabled
crossDomainInteractions: Aggregates tree/capture coordinates from the Tree & Capture Data domain to compute bounds
Bounds are computed per stakeholder (planter, organization) from the Stakeholder Directory domain

nodes.name: Token & Transaction Ledger
nodes.summary: Impact accounting layer. Exposes issued tokens (linked to captures and wallets), token transactions between wallets, wallet records, and contract records. Read-only queries with filtering, counting, and pagination.

businessRules: Tokens link a capture to a wallet and track transfer and claim state
Transactions record source and destination wallets with processing metadata
Tokens, transactions, and contracts are queried by id and by filter with counts
crossDomainInteractions: Tokens reference captures in the Tree & Capture Data domain
Wallets are associated with growers/stakeholders in the Stakeholder Directory domain

nodes.name: Query Trees
nodes.summary: Return trees matching filters (organization, date, tag, wallet, geometry), fetch a tree by id/UUID, provide counts, or return featured trees.

nodes.name: Query Captures
nodes.summary: Return processed tree captures matching filters, fetch a capture by id, or return capture counts.

nodes.name: Query Raw Captures
nodes.summary: Return raw (unprocessed) tree captures matching filters, fetch one by id, or return counts.

nodes.name: Query Planters
nodes.summary: Return planters by filter, fetch a planter by id, or return featured planters, with HATEOAS links to trees, organizations, and species.

nodes.name: Query Grower Accounts
nodes.summary: Return grower accounts, counts, featured growers, wallets, and selfies, or a single grower by id, with HATEOAS links.

nodes.name: Query Organizations
nodes.summary: Return organizations by filter, fetch by id, or return featured organizations; v2 additionally supports grower-based lookups. Builds organization resource links.

nodes.name: Query Species
nodes.summary: Return species matching a filter (keyword, morphology, range) or fetch a single species by id, grouped and counted by organization, planter, or wallet.

nodes.name: Compute Map Bounds
nodes.summary: Compute a geographic bounding box for a planter, wallet, or organization from tree capture coordinates so the web map can frame its view.

nodes.name: Find Nearest GIS Feature
nodes.summary: Resolve the nearest geographic feature to a supplied lat/lon point using raw PostGIS distance queries.

nodes.name: Query Countries & Leaderboard
nodes.summary: Return country records by id or spatial filter with GeoJSON centroids, and a planting leaderboard aggregated by region, optionally served from an LRU cache.

nodes.name: Query Tokens
nodes.summary: Return issued tokens matching a filter with counts and pagination, or fetch a single token by id.

nodes.name: Query Transactions
nodes.summary: Return token transactions between wallets via filtered lookups over a database session.

nodes.name: Query Contracts
nodes.summary: Return contract records by filter, fetch by id, or return contract counts using dynamic where-clause building.

nodes.name: Validate request params
nodes.summary: The trees router validates query parameters with Joi and selects the route (list, by id, count, or featured).

nodes.name: Normalize query filter
nodes.summary: queryFormatter parses and normalizes query params, JSON-decoding where/in clauses and coercing numeric filters.

nodes.name: Dispatch to filter resolver
nodes.summary: Tree model getByFilter dispatches to the correct repository method based on the active filter (organization, date, tag, wallet, geometry).

nodes.name: Run tree SQL query
nodes.summary: TreeRepository runs the knex/pg query by id, UUID, organization, date range, tag, wallet, or geometry with pagination.

nodes.name: Count matching trees
nodes.summary: Tree model countByFilter dispatches to the matching repository count method for the count endpoints.

nodes.name: Return JSON response
nodes.summary: The router serializes trees (or featured trees) to JSON; the async handler wrapper forwards any error to the global handler.

nodes.name: Validate capture params
nodes.summary: The captures router validates query parameters with Joi and selects list, by-id, or count route.

nodes.name: Delegate to Capture model
nodes.summary: The Capture business model exposes query and count operations delegating to the capture repository.

nodes.name: Build capture where-clause
nodes.summary: CaptureRepository filterWhereBuilder builds the dynamic where-clause from the filter and paginates.

nodes.name: Return capture JSON
nodes.summary: The router serializes captures or count to JSON.

nodes.name: Validate raw-capture params
nodes.summary: The raw-captures router validates query parameters with Joi and selects list, by-id, or count route.

nodes.name: Delegate to RawCapture model
nodes.summary: The RawCapture business model exposes query and count operations delegating to the raw-capture repository.

nodes.name: Build raw-capture query
nodes.summary: RawCaptureRepository builds the dynamic where-clause, paginates, and counts raw captures.

nodes.name: Return raw-capture JSON
nodes.summary: The router serializes raw captures or count to JSON.

nodes.name: Route planter request
nodes.summary: The planters router selects list, by-id, or featured route and forwards the query.

nodes.name: Filter planters in model
nodes.summary: The Planter model exposes filter, count, name lookup, and featured operations over the planter repository.

nodes.name: Run planter SQL query
nodes.summary: PlanterRepository queries planters by id, organization, filter, and name plus counts and featured planters.

nodes.name: Build HATEOAS links
nodes.summary: The Planter model builds resource links to featured trees, organizations, and species for each planter.

nodes.name: Return planter JSON
nodes.summary: The router serializes planters (or featured planters) to JSON.

nodes.name: Validate grower request
nodes.summary: The grower accounts router validates query params with Joi and routes count, featured, wallets, selfies, by-id, or list.

nodes.name: Resolve grower use-case
nodes.summary: The GrowerAccount model curries the repository into single-purpose use-case functions and builds HATEOAS links.

nodes.name: Run grower SQL query
nodes.summary: GrowerAccountRepository queries grower accounts, wallets, and selfies from the database session.

nodes.name: Return grower JSON
nodes.summary: The router serializes grower accounts, counts, wallets, or selfies to JSON.

nodes.name: Route organization request
nodes.summary: The organizations router (v1/v2) selects list, by-id, featured, or grower-based route.

nodes.name: Filter organizations in model
nodes.summary: The Organization model filters records via the repository and maps results.

nodes.name: Run organization SQL query
nodes.summary: OrganizationRepository retrieves organizations by planter, id, map name, ids, and featured selection (v2 adds getByGrower).

nodes.name: Build organization links
nodes.summary: The Organization model builds HATEOAS links to featured trees, associated planters, and species.

nodes.name: Return organization JSON
nodes.summary: The router serializes organizations to JSON.

nodes.name: Route species request
nodes.summary: The species router selects list or by-id route filtered by organization, planter, or wallet.

nodes.name: Delegate species query
nodes.summary: The Species model getByFilter/countByFilter delegate the query to the species repository.

nodes.name: Run species SQL query
nodes.summary: SpeciesRepository fetches species grouped by organization, planter, or wallet with counting.

nodes.name: Return species JSON
nodes.summary: The router serializes the species list or single record to JSON.

nodes.name: Validate bounds params
nodes.summary: The bounds router validates query params with Joi (planter, wallet, or organization filter) and delegates to the Bounds model.

nodes.name: Resolve bounds filter
nodes.summary: The Bounds model getByFilter returns a filter function that computes map bounding boxes from the bounds repository.

nodes.name: Compute bounds from captures
nodes.summary: BoundsRepository computes geographic bounds by planter, wallet, or organization from tree capture coordinates and converts bound strings.

nodes.name: Return bounding box
nodes.summary: The router serializes the computed bounding box to JSON.

nodes.name: Route GIS request
nodes.summary: The GIS router exposes the nearest-feature endpoint and delegates to the Gis model.

nodes.name: Delegate nearest lookup
nodes.summary: The Gis model delegates the nearest-feature lookup to the GIS repository.

nodes.name: Run PostGIS nearest query
nodes.summary: GisRepository getNearest validates coordinates and runs a raw PostGIS distance query, then JSON-parses the result.

nodes.name: Return nearest feature
nodes.summary: The router serializes the nearest feature to JSON.

nodes.name: Validate & cache country request
nodes.summary: The countries router validates params with Joi.assert and applies express-lru caching gated by CACHE_ENABLED, routing leaderboard, by-id, or list.

nodes.name: Compose country operations
nodes.summary: The Country model composes getCountries plus repository-delegated getById, getByFilter, and getLeaderBoard operations.

nodes.name: Run country query & aggregation
nodes.summary: CountryRepository runs getById, getByFilter, and the getLeaderBoard aggregation with PostGIS GeoJSON centroid serialization.

nodes.name: Return country JSON
nodes.summary: The router serializes country records or the leaderboard to JSON, caching where enabled.

nodes.name: Validate token params
nodes.summary: The tokens router validates query params and routes list (with pagination) or by-id lookup.

nodes.name: Delegate token query
nodes.summary: The Tokens model getByFilter/getCountByFilter call the tokens repository.

nodes.name: Run token SQL query
nodes.summary: TokensRepository queries issued tokens by id and filter with count support over the knex session.

nodes.name: Return token JSON
nodes.summary: The router serializes tokens or a single token to JSON.

nodes.name: Route transaction request
nodes.summary: The transactions router exposes the transaction endpoint and opens a database Session.

nodes.name: Delegate transaction query
nodes.summary: The Transaction model getByFilter delegates to the transaction repository.

nodes.name: Run transaction SQL query
nodes.summary: TransactionRepository provides filtered lookups over source and destination wallets, extending BaseRepository.

nodes.name: Return transaction JSON
nodes.summary: The router serializes the transactions to JSON.

nodes.name: Validate contract params
nodes.summary: The contracts router validates query params with Joi and routes list, by-id, or count.

nodes.name: Delegate contract query
nodes.summary: The Contract model exposes query and count operations delegating to the contract repository.

nodes.name: Build contract where-clause
nodes.summary: ContractRepository builds a dynamic where-clause and runs filtered queries and counts.

nodes.name: Return contract JSON
nodes.summary: The router serializes contract records or count to JSON.

edges.description: Map bounds are computed from tree capture coordinates owned by the Tree & Capture Data domain.
Planter, grower, and organization responses embed HATEOAS links to their featured trees.
Stakeholder responses link to the species associated with a planter or organization.
Tokens reference the tree capture they were issued for.
Wallets and transactions belong to growers/stakeholders in the directory.
